Design credits

Q-ZIPS artwork

The Q-ZIPS promotional artwork and installer were supplied for this website. Q-ZIPS is presented as a Q-CUBIC product, consistent with the artwork and installer metadata.

Design guidance

This website applies design guidance from unslop, created by Damir Sokolovsky, licensed under CC BY 4.0. The guidance was adapted for Q-ZIPS: restrained violet accents, consistent spacing, plain feature descriptions and a focus on the supplied product artwork. This credit does not imply endorsement.

Product illustrations

The feature diagrams on this website are explanatory illustrations. They are not screenshots or a browser-based version of Q-ZIPS.
